description: Diagnostic module for anti_entropy daemon staleness (4h1m). anti_entropy is NOT a protected file — diagnostic is appropriate. Module must: (1) get_service_health for anti_entropy, (2) tail log file for last activity, (3) check if anti_entropy work queue (entropy check targets) is accumulating faster than daemon processes them, (4) write_diagnostic_blob with findings and staleness gap. Exposes: run().
